title: ci_fix_result — review-merge CI-fix agent's report (task 10)
description: The CI-fix agent's output (docs/stage-io, task 10). The gate's shape checks are outcome enum + scope literal ci_only; reason is required when outcome is cannot_fix. `risk` is not part of this contract. _io is stamped by the server.

outcome.description: fixed: the failing check was made to pass. cannot_fix is the ask-a-human outcome and is terminal for the merge.

scope.description: The only files this report claims are outside the reviewed change set.

reason.description: Required when outcome is cannot_fix: what a human must decide or do, published verbatim in the PR.
